verdicts.rationale: REST v2 POST /collections/create endpoint accepts vectorFieldType parameter but completely ignores it. Source code analysis confirms: (1) CollectionReq struct lacks vectorFieldType field, (2) createCollection handler hardcodes DataType_FloatVector at line 1919, (3) No validation exists for vectorFieldType values. This is a genuine API defect where the parameter surface accepts user input but has no implementation, creating a false impression of configurability. Matches known REST v2 data type handling issues (milvus/issues/52232, 52230, 52229).
